evaluation_method: Run each prompt with and without the skill against the same tools, evidence and model configuration. Review required behaviors, forbidden behaviors, source accuracy and unnecessary tool use. Record outputs and scores; packaging tests are not a behavioral benchmark.

cases.prompt: Add Apple Pay to a physical-goods web checkout; the PSP is not selected.
Replace all in-app purchases for premium AI credits with an Apple Pay button in every iOS storefront.
must_not_include: AI relabeled as one-to-one human service

cases.prompt: US external payment links are allowed, so enable native Apple Pay for digital goods worldwide.
must_include: distinguish external link from embedded checkout
must_not_include: global permission inferred from US rule

cases.prompt: Plan Apple Pay for a Flutter or React Native store selling shipped products.
The checkout runs on Windows Chrome and capability status is unknown. Hide Apple Pay?
Stripe test keys are enabled, so rewrite every Apple validation URL to the Apple sandbox host.
must_not_include: automatic test-key to Apple sandbox mapping

cases.prompt: Proxy any client validationURL with the merchant identity certificate and follow redirects.
The payment sheet timed out after authorization. Retry with a fresh idempotency key and another processor.
Two success event types and a replay arrive after a refund; a worker also crashed.
Use Apple Pay for monthly charges and automatically replay the first payment token.
must_include: one-time token versus reusable provider reference

cases.prompt: A country appears in Apple's sandbox card list; promise production acceptance there.
Stripe hosted checkout already offers Apple Pay. Add custom Merchant ID and mTLS validation for every customer.
To repair staging, revoke our production processing certificate and paste its private key into the issue.
Send wallet tokens, addresses and sensitive customer context to analytics to debug conversion.
must_include: eligible funnel and sanitized error classes

cases.prompt: Implement NFC Tap to Pay terminal acceptance and issue a new payment card.
must_not_include: online Apple Pay skill claimed sufficient for issuing or terminals

cases.prompt: The Markdown validator passed; declare merchant approval and successful live payments.
